title: Lead Statuses
description: The stages a lead moves through in your pipeline (e.g. New, Interested, Converted). Rename, recolour, reorder, or set a default for new leads. Statuses can't be deleted — leads keep their history. Stored in the database so you can filter and report on them.
empty: No statuses yet. Add your first pipeline stage below.

row.showInFilterTitle: Hidden from the status filter — click to show it
row.hideFromFilterTitle: Shown in the status filter — click to hide it

footer.hint: The starred status is applied to brand-new leads.

admissionRule.title: When a lead is moved to {{status}} without a course
admissionRule.description: Choose what happens when staff move a lead to this status and the person has no course or fee plan here yet. Admissions without a course or fees leave your revenue reports short. Automations, AI calls and enrolments are never held back.
admissionRule.offHint: No check is made. This is the default.
admissionRule.warnHint: Staff see a confirmation and can still go ahead.
admissionRule.block: Require a course or fee plan
admissionRule.blockHint: Staff can’t move a lead to {{status}} until the person has a course or fee plan.
admissionRule.saveFailed: Failed to save the admission rule
admissionRule.loadFailed: Couldn’t load this setting. Refresh the page to try again.
